meta.anchorTruth: After Ji-yeon Park became convinced that her husband had started another life, she manipulated the power of attorney to cancel the joint savings account of 20 million won, and transferred the entire amount to an investment room, but lost it through fraud. Lee Jun-ho was not having an affair, but was taking care of his brother's nephew (second year of middle school), who was undergoing personal rehabilitation, and gave 30 million won in cash from his personal slush fund to his brother.
meta.emotionalBait: My husband stops by the same officetel every day after work. A receipt for feminine products found in the car. Early morning calls. The wife is convinced of her husband's other life.
meta.resolutionDilemma: Who should bear greater responsibility: the husband, who transferred 30 million won of his personal slush fund in cash to protect his brother and nephew, who were in rehabilitation, or the wife, who, convinced that she had been betrayed, manipulated the power of attorney to cancel the joint savings account of 20 million won and then lost the entire amount in investment fraud. The husband first hid it, the wife first monitored the account, and the wife committed the crime.
meta.title: A husband who stays at the officetel every day without his wife knowing.

context.description: My husband stops by the same officetel every day after work. A receipt for feminine products found in the car. Early morning calls. The wife is convinced of her husband's other life.
context.triggerAmplifier: In the beginning, it looks like an affair because the receipts (hair band/tint), officetel GPS, and early morning phone calls overlap in only one direction. However, the more clues are uncovered, the more the picture shakes, and as the unsaid circumstances of both sides and the movement of money are revealed one after another, the focus of the case turns beyond suspicion of infidelity.

disputes.name: Officetel visit and early morning phone call
disputes.truthDescription: The visit to the officetel was to take care of my nephew (second year of middle school) at my brother's officetel. The early morning call is an emergency call with my brother.
disputes.mediationLink: Misunderstandings about infidelity and family care
disputes.judgmentStatement: The reality of the officetel visit was not an affair, but family care.

verdictOptions.wrong: Lee Jun-ho's visit to the officetel was due to living in a different house.
verdictOptions.partial: Visiting an officetel is not the same as living with someone else, but it is highly likely to be an affair.
verdictOptions.truth: The reality of the officetel visit was not an affair, but family care.
verdictOptions.defer: Currently, the reality is unknown. Reserve judgment.

disputes.name: Withdrawal of lump sum from account in husband's name
disputes.truthDescription: Lee Jun-ho withdrew 30 million won in slush funds from a separate account in his name, which he had saved for nearly 10 years without his wife's knowledge, in the order of 5 million won, 8 million won, 7 million won, and 10 million won over the past four months. The explanation is that the money was delivered in cash as it was difficult for my brother to deposit money into his bank account as he was in the process of personal rehabilitation, and it was personal funds that had nothing to do with joint savings.
disputes.mediationLink: How the Husband's Cash Flow Is Used
disputes.judgmentStatement: The husband is more responsible for delivering 30 million won in personal slush funds.

disputes.name: How 20 million won in joint savings was canceled
disputes.truthDescription: Traces of the joint savings account being canceled before maturity were confirmed. During the termination process, issues remain regarding whether the spouse consents and the authenticity of the power of attorney, and the actual destination of the 20 million won termination payment still needs to be confirmed. Now, the circumstances of joint savings cancellation and responsibility for the procedure are traced as separate issues.
disputes.mediationLink: Disposal of joint assets and losses
disputes.judgmentStatement: The wife is more responsible for manipulating and canceling the 20 million won joint savings power of attorney.

verdictOptions.wrong: Lee Jun-ho secretly canceled the joint savings of 20 million won and took it as a slush fund.

disputes.name: The order of concealment and preemptive action
disputes.truthDescription: B is the first to hide (concealing the 30 million+ personal slush fund situation), A is the first to monitor the accounts (early newlyweds), money is executed at the same time (B 4 months ago, 30 million cash withdrawal, A 6 weeks ago, joint savings 20 million won manipulation and termination of power of attorney), and criminal activity is A (manipulation of power of attorney).
disputes.judgmentStatement: The precedence and absence of concealment and the presence or absence of criminal activity are two different dimensions.

v3UnlockPlan.runtimeRule: Automatically unlocked when both A/B reaches d-2 S3 + h-d3 S3
v3UnlockPlan.authoredRule: Both d-2 and h-d3 are automatically expressed after being released.

verdictOptions.wrong: Since Lee Jun-ho created the secret first, Park Ji-yeon's actions were a self-rescue measure.
verdictOptions.partial: Both sides have something to hide, but it is difficult to determine the sequential relationship.
verdictOptions.truth: Lee Jun-ho was the first to hide it, and Park Ji-yeon was the first to monitor the account. The criminal act (manipulating the power of attorney) is on Park Ji-yeon’s side.
verdictOptions.defer: There is insufficient evidence to determine who came first. I reserve it.
